c1d-crab-bug: This plan has a bug. Press Go to watch where it goes wrong, then tap the card to fix it.
c1d-crab-tray: The tray is too small for one card per step. Build a Repeat block, put cards inside, and choose how many times it runs.
c1d-crab-tide-rules: Low sand floods once the crab has walked the tide number of squares. Turns do not count. Cross the low sand while it is still dry.
c1d-crab-key-rules: The gate stays locked until the crab walks over the key. Then the gate is open for the rest of the plan.
c1d-crab-song-rules: A song keeps a group of cards. Build the group, press Make plan a song, then call the song wherever the group comes again.
c1d-crab-fog-rules: Fog hides which beach this is, so one plan must work on every beach shown. Use If blocked to choose: turn when the way is blocked, otherwise walk.
c1d-crab-two-rules: Two crabs follow the same plan. Every card moves both. A crab that would bump just stays where it is, so a wall can hold one crab still.
c1d-crab-lesson-tide-1: Low sand floods once the crab has walked the tide number of squares. Cross while it is dry.
c1d-crab-lesson-tide-2: The tide is just long enough. Do not take extra steps.
c1d-crab-lesson-tide-3: The shortest route gets cut off by the tide. Which shell should the crab visit first?
c1d-crab-lesson-tide-4: A short beach with a fast tide. Plan the route before you press Go.
c1d-crab-lesson-tide-5: One last low-sand crossing, with time to spare.
c1d-crab-lesson-key-1: The gate opens once the crab holds the key. Walk over the key, then through the gate.
c1d-crab-lesson-key-2: The key is not on the way. Fetch it first, then come back to the gate.
c1d-crab-lesson-key-3: Shells, a key and a gate. Which should the crab visit first?
c1d-crab-lesson-key-4: The gate is right beside the crab, but the key is not.
c1d-crab-lesson-songs-1: Build a group of cards, then press Make plan a song. Call the song wherever the group comes again.
c1d-crab-lesson-songs-2: The same group of cards comes three times, with other cards between. A song saves blocks.
c1d-crab-lesson-songs-3: Different cards sit between the groups. Find the group that comes back.
c1d-crab-lesson-songs-4: The tray is tight. Only one song fits.
c1d-crab-lesson-fog-1: Fog hides which beach this is. One plan must work on both. Use If blocked inside a Repeat.
c1d-crab-lesson-fog-2: Try one card before the Repeat. Where should the crab face before it starts?
c1d-crab-lesson-fog-3: This beach needs a longer plan. Try two cards in one branch.
c1d-crab-lesson-fog-4: Two foggy beaches and a tight tray with no spare block. The shortest plans from the last beaches will not work here.
c1d-crab-lesson-fog-5: One more foggy walk home, with room to spare.
c1d-crab-lesson-two-1: Two crabs, one plan. Every card moves both crabs. Bring each crab to a home.
c1d-crab-lesson-two-2: A crab that would bump just stays where it is. Use the edge to hold one crab still.
c1d-crab-lesson-two-3: Use a sandcastle to hold one crab while the other walks on.
c1d-crab-lesson-two-4: A short plan for two crabs. Which crab should wait?
